default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-588.title: Mean-of-daily-highs/lows band poke fade
E-588.hypothesis: The average of the last n sessions' highs (lows) is a level where recent days' rallies (dips) typically ended; a bar that pokes through it and closes back is a failed push into resting supply/demand; fade it.

E-589.title: Zero-lag EMA slope turn follow
E-589.hypothesis: A zero-lag EMA turns before a plain EMA; when its slope turns with price on the same side, short-horizon momentum followers pile in for a few more bars.

E-590.title: Chande momentum extreme fade
E-590.hypothesis: When nearly all price change in the window has been one-directional (CMO beyond a threshold) and it first relaxes, the one-sided flow is fading and the pullback side takes over; trade the relaxation.

E-591.title: Relative volatility index cross follow
E-591.hypothesis: Volatility concentrated in up-closes (or down-closes) shows where the large flow sits; follow when the relative volatility index moves beyond a threshold.

E-592.title: Piercing line / dark-cloud cover at a window extreme
E-592.hypothesis: A bar that reverses more than a fraction of the previous opposite body right at a window extreme shows aggressive counter flow absorbing the move; trade the reversal.

E-593.title: EMA ribbon alignment onset follow
E-593.hypothesis: When four EMAs (u, 2u, 3u, 5u bars) first line up in order with a minimum spread, trend followers at all horizons agree; the first aligned bar is an entry in that direction.

E-594.title: Stochastic RSI hook out of the extreme
E-594.hypothesis: RSI at the bottom (top) of its own recent range then rising (falling) back through the threshold marks a momentum turn inside the window; trade the turn.

E-595.title: Prior-session projected-range level fade
E-595.hypothesis: The projected high/low computed from the previous session's open, high, low and close (DeMark range projection) is a level watched by a minority of traders; a poke that closes back is fading.

E-596.title: Stochastic centre-of-gravity turn
E-596.hypothesis: The recency-weighted centre of gravity of prices turns before price itself; when it turns out of the extreme of its own window, the swing in that window is ending.

E-597.title: Price-volume-trend EMA cross follow
E-597.hypothesis: Cumulating volume times return weighs moves by participation; the PVT crossing its EMA means volume is now backing the new direction.
